WELCOME TO PULLMAN MAGENTA SHORES RESORT
LUXURY ESCAPE AMONG THE BEST HOTELS ON THE CENTRAL COAST NSW
Located just 90 minutes from Sydney and only 20 minutes north of Terrigal, Pullman Magenta Shores Resort is an exceptional golf , spa and corporate retreat offering premium apartment style  accommodation and a unique beachfront setting delivering exceptional weddings , conferences and events on the Central Coast, NSW.
Nestled between the pristine waters of the Pacific Ocean and Tuggerah Lake, this magnificent resort is set on 52 acres and has been designed to complement its spectacular location featuring an amazing array of coastal flora and fauna.
Our stunning Central Coast resort offers beautifully appointed apartment style accommodation , including Studio Guestrooms and One, Two, Three and Four Bedroom Villas that complement the physical landscape and relaxed Central Coast lifestyle. Our Exclusive Retreats accommodation offers luxury beach houses and terraces ideal for a family getaway, corporate retreat or beachside elopement . The resort accommodation is set amongst landscaped gardens and just a short stroll from all resort facilities and the beach. All villas include open plan living areas, fully equipped kitchens with European appliances, laundry facilities and private furnished courtyards or balconies.
Every Studio Guestroom or Villa enjoys views of either the golf course , outdoor  pools or our beautiful landscaped gardens.
Our resort has exceptional leisure facilities including access to e-bikes to venture to The Entrance or Wyrrabolong National Park, as well as the private and exclusively designed Ross Watson 18 hole Championship Magenta Shores Golf and Country Club .
Relax in one of the Resort's three  swimming areas , including a 20 metre indoor heated lap pool, Rock Pools or the Lagoon Pool with seasonal pool bar.
Vie Spa  consists of five luxurious treatment rooms, including a couple’s suite, Vichy shower and a tranquil spa garden designed to deliver the ultimate relaxation experience perfect for enjoying a signature high tea.
Barretts Restaurant is the perfect place to relax and enjoy fine food and the stunning vistas of the Magenta Shores Golf Course and lake. There is also Shallows Bar , a casual, family-friendly bar that features an indoor fireplace and alfresco dining daily. We do also welcome Central Coast locals to dine in our modern restaurant and bar areas and the spaces have been recently renovated with seasonal menus and an extensive beverage menu including happy hour, to ensure there is something for everyone to enjoy.
For signature meetings, conferences, weddings and private functions on the Central Coast, Pullman Magenta Shores Resort features six modern conference and event spaces along with a dedicated and experienced team to support you with customised planning and inhouse resort catering services, ensuring delivery of a successful event for you and your guests.
Whether you’re seeking a tranquil resort to escape the bustle of the city for a weekend of relaxation or a first-class hotel for a conference on the Central Coast, Pullman Magenta Shores Resort is the perfect place to create your memorable experience.

THE PREMIER CENTRAL COAST HOLIDAY ACCOMMODATION IN MAGENTA SHORES
Pullman Magenta Shores Resort offers beautifully appointed apartment style accommodation including: Studio Apartments and One, Two and Three Bedroom Villas that complement the physical landscape and relaxed nature of a coastal lifestyle. For some added luxury we have Deluxe Villas that are newly available, so you can enjoy the utmost comfort and luxury. Set amongst landscaped gardens and just a short stroll from all resort facilities and the beach, our Central Coast accommodation options enjoy the highest comfort in a luxury environment. All villas include open plan living areas, fully equipped kitchens with European appliances, Wi-Fi Internet access, laundry facilities and private furnished courtyards or balconies.
Every guestroom or villa enjoys views of the golf course, lagoon pool, rock pools or landscaped gardens.
All of this makes our resort the best option for your accommodation on the Central Coast NSW.
Our resort is also ideal for conference and event accommodation on the Central Coast. Stay while you conference with your delegates in one of six conference rooms overlooking our golf course and lake. It is also the ideal location for team building events and social events including weddings, parties and anniversaries.
When you stay in one of our guestrooms or villas at our premium resort, make sure you take advantage of the great facilities that are located on our property including the golf course, Vie Spa, beachfront access, tennis courts, restaurant & bar and indoor & outdoor pools.

Long Stay at Pullman Magenta Shores Resort
Pullman Magenta Shores offers an exceptional long-stay experience, perfect for those seeking a tranquil retreat on the Central Coast of New South Wales. With its breathtaking location nestled between the pristine waters of the Pacific Ocean and Tuggerah Lake, guests are treated to stunning views and serene surroundings. The resort features beautifully appointed villas and apartments, equipped with all modern conveniences to make your stay comfortable and memorable. Guests can enjoy access to world-class facilities, including a golf course, tennis courts, and a luxurious day spa. Whether for work or leisure, a long stay at Pullman Magenta Shores promises relaxation and rejuvenation.
1 Bedroom Villa
Experience tranquillity and sophistication at the one-bedroom villa in Pullman Magenta Shores, located on the scenic Central Coast of New South Wales. This villa offers a perfect blend of luxury and comfort, with a spacious living area adorned with modern furnishings and a fully equipped kitchen for your culinary adventures. The bedroom is a sanctuary of relaxation, featuring plush bedding and elegant decor. Step outside to your private patio or enjoy the lush surroundings of the resort. With easy access to pristine beaches, a world-class golf course, and exquisite dining options, it's an ideal retreat for couples and solo travellers alike.
2 Bedroom Villa
Located on the stunning Central Coast of New South Wales, the two-bedroom villa at Pullman Magenta Shores offers an exquisite blend of comfort and sophistication. Perfect for families or groups, the villa boasts a spacious layout with a fully equipped kitchen, elegant living and dining areas, and two tastefully designed bedrooms with luxurious bedding. Guests can relax on the private terrace, taking in views of the beautifully landscaped gardens or the serene golf course. The resort's proximity to pristine beaches and vibrant local attractions makes it an exceptional choice for both relaxation and adventure.
3 Bedroom Villa
Experience unparalleled luxury and comfort in the three-bedroom villa at Pullman Magenta Shores. Situated along the stunning Central Coast of New South Wales, this villa offers an elegant retreat with ample space for families or groups. The villa features a fully equipped kitchen, a spacious living and dining area, and three beautifully appointed bedrooms with quality linens. Relax on the private terrace or garden, taking in views of the lush golf course and tranquil surroundings. With access to resort amenities, including a world-class golf course, swimming pools, and fine dining, it's the perfect setting for a memorable getaway.

Enjoy casual cuisine in the privacy of your luxurious studio or villa at Pullman Magenta Shores Resort. You can experience our amazing Bar Menu from the comfort of your accommodation and be sure you won't be left feeling hungry.
Choose from a selection of dishes that can be shared with family and friends or to enjoy solo, whilst soaking in the sea breeze at our Central Coast Luxury Resort.
Our in-room dining menu is changed seasonally to guarantee the best quality and flavour using seasonal produce from local suppliers. It follows our Shallows Bar menu which includes a variety of casual dining options.
To order from our In Room Dining Menu please dial the room service number on your room phone.
